title: Cancellation Reasons, Documentation and Refund Methods — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Cancellation of NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**Signed request.** A cancellation is processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request on file for the policy. The request is the one recorded on Tidemark's request records for that policy, matched by its request reference; a verbal statement does not take its place.

**Status.** The policy status must be pending effective or in force when the cancellation is processed, and it is cancelled once processed.

**Reasons, documents and effective dates.** Each reason carries its own documentation and effective date:

| Reason | Documentation | Effective date | Refund method |
|---|---|---|---|
| Building Sold | Closing disclosure or settlement statement | Title transfer date | Pro Rata |
| Building Removed or Demolished | Evidence of removal | Removal date | Pro Rata |
| Contents Sold or Removed (contents-only policies) | — | Date the contents left the premises | Pro Rata |
| Duplicate NFIP Policy | The other policy's declarations | Original effective date of the later-dated policy, which is the one cancelled | Full from Inception |
| Closing Did Not Occur | The lender's statement that the loan did not close | Original effective date | Full from Inception |
| Removed from SFHA by LOMA or LOMR | FEMA Letter of Map Amendment or Revision | Current term start | Current Term Full |
| Mortgage Paid Off | Payoff letter | See the backdating clause below | Pro Rata |
| Voluntary — Not Required | No document | See the backdating clause below | Pro Rata |
| Replaced by Private Flood | The private policy's declarations | See the backdating clause below | Pro Rata |

**Backdating clause for the last three reasons.** *Clause no longer in force:* "for these three the effective date may not be earlier than the tier's voluntary backdate period before the date the signed request is received, and for Replaced by Private Flood it is the private policy's effective date when that is later". This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Lender release.** A cancellation for Mortgage Paid Off, Voluntary — Not Required, Replaced by Private Flood or Removed from SFHA by LOMA or LOMR on a mortgage-required policy needs the lender's written release on file, as shown on the request record.

**Refund methods.** The refund method follows the reason. Full from Inception returns every component booked on the policy, fees included. Current Term Full returns the current term's risk premium, ICC premium, Reserve Fund Assessment and HFIAA surcharge in full. *Clause no longer in force:* "Pro Rata returns the same four components of the current term multiplied by the days from the cancellation effective date to the term end divided by the days from the term start to the term end". This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. Each component is rounded half-up to the tier's refund rounding increment before the components are added. Under Current Term Full and Pro Rata the Federal Policy Fee and probation surcharge are fully earned (the tier does not refund them on a pro rata or current-term refund).

**Claim bar.** *Clause no longer in force:* "No refund at all is due for the current term under the claim-bar reasons (Mortgage Paid Off, Voluntary — Not Required, Replaced by Private Flood, Removed from SFHA by LOMA or LOMR) when a claim with a date of loss in the current term has been paid (a claim whose payments, net of voided payments, are above zero) or is still open (a reported claim with neither a payment nor a denial on record); the cancellation still proceeds." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Booking and payee.** Each refunded component is booked as a cancellation credit referencing the cancellation request, and the total is refunded to the payor of record. When the policy is mortgage-required, the mortgagee of record is notified of the cancellation.

| Condition on the records | Cancellation |
|---|---|
| No signed request on file for the policy | Not processed |
| Status other than pending effective or in force | Not processed |
| Mortgage-required policy, one of the four reasons needing a release, no written lender release on file | Not processed |

superseded_clauses: for these three the effective date may not be earlier than voluntary_backdate_days before the date the signed request is received, and for REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD it is the private policy's effective date when that is later
PRO_RATA returns the same four components of the current term multiplied by the days from the cancellation effective date to term_end divided by the days from term_start to term_end
